cases.question: Tell me about Pdfroo
cases.judge_reason: All claims match the expected facts and known public details about Pdfroo.
cases.answer:
**Pdfroo** is Ayush's fully client-side PDF editor — open a PDF in your browser, annotate, sign, rearrange/merge pages, compress, find & replace, and download a real flattened PDF. **Nothing uploads**; all parsing, rendering, and writing happen locally via **pdf.js + pdf-lib**, and it works offline once loaded.

**Highlights**
- Runs on phones (375 px), tablets (768 px), desktops (1440 px+) — mouse, pen, or touch
- No build step, no backend, no install — just open `index.html` or the live demo
- Thumbnail sidebar (desktop), slide-in drawer (tablet), bottom sheet (phone)
- Drag-to-reorder (SortableJS, touch-friendly long-press), rotate, duplicate, delete, insert blank, merge PDFs
- After first successful download: a kangaroo toast — *"Done! Your PDF never left your device. Go enjoy a coffee ☕"*
- Landing page with local fonts, SVG mascot, drag-and-drop zone, built-in sample PDF, Indian-language section, privacy "pouch promise"
- Light/dark theme, MIT licensed

**Links**
- Live demo: https://ayush4u.github.io/pdfroo/
- Repo: https://github.com/ayush4u/pdfroo (JavaScript, CSS, HTML)
